newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong air cargo throughput climbs in October.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong air cargo throughput climbs in October.

text.p: Hong Kong Air Cargo Terminal Limited (HACTL) said total air cargo throughout at Kai Tak airport increased by almost 10 percent in October, a HACTL release said.
The latest figures show October's total of 146,853 tonnes was 9.9 percent ahead of the 133,592 tonnes in October 1995.
HACTL reported strong all-round growth as exports increased 11 percent to 77,075 tonnes, imports climbed 9.4 percent to 52,195 tonnes and transhipments grew 6.9 percent to 17,583 tonnes.

"The latest monthly figures are indicative of the seasonal surge we usually experience at this time of the year as manufacturers rush to get their products to overseas markets in time for Christmas," HACTL managing director Anthony Charter said.
"October and November are two of our busiest months and October's encouraging figures reflect that HACTL remains firmly on target to set a new record for the full year." Charter added.

Cumulatively, HACTL has handled almost 1.2 million tonnes in the year to 31 October or 4.7 percent more than the 1.146 million tonnes in the same period last year, HCATL added. -Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
